senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; חָרַשׁ I)ploughing, ploughing season. Mekh. Vayakhel (ref. to Ex. XXXIV, 21) שבות מח׳ וכ׳ cease from ploughing &c.
units: <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 9a:4">R. Hash. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ של ערב וכ׳</he> a ploughing at the eve of the Sabbatical year (in the sixth year) which enters into (effects the growth of) the Sabbatical year; a. e.
